author: TeIq
content: Delivered: 4-crate Cargo workspace (polaris-types, polaris-backend, polaris-frontend, xtask) with edition 2024 / rust-version 1.85 / strict workspace lints / shared dep pins via [workspace.dependencies]. polaris-types verified clean of proto-blue (AC-8). clippy.toml doc-valid-idents covers project terminology. .cargo/config.toml aliases xtask. README quickstart updated. Build + clippy + fmt clean on the crates that don't transitively depend on proto-blue; full workspace build blocked by upstream proto-blue MSRV bug now tracked at #50.
